dna_adenine.label: Adenine (A)
dna_adenine.info: Always pairs with thymine through two hydrogen bonds.

dna_thymine.label: Thymine (T)
dna_thymine.info: Pairs with adenine; RNA uses uracil instead.

dna_guanine.label: Guanine (G)
dna_guanine.info: Pairs with cytosine through three hydrogen bonds.

dna_cytosine.label: Cytosine (C)
dna_cytosine.info: Pairs with guanine; G-C pairs make DNA more stable.

dna_phosphate.label: Phosphate group
dna_phosphate.info: Links the sugars and gives DNA its negative charge.

dna_sugar.label: Deoxyribose
dna_sugar.info: The sugar every base is attached to.

dna_backbone.label: Sugar-phosphate backbone
dna_backbone.info: The outer strand: one full turn every 10.5 base pairs.

dna_hydrogen_bond.label: Hydrogen bonds
dna_hydrogen_bond.info: Hold the two bases of a pair together.
